_note: 英語島文法分區 sidecar：一檔一單元一 KP。unit_id＝KP id＝eng.t_sub.verb.past-perfect-progressive（過去完成進行式，tier t_adv／學測級）。形式＝had been ＋ V-ing（現在分詞）。意思：到過去某個時點為止『一直持續』的動作，常搭配 for／since；也常用來解釋過去某狀況的原因/結果（The ground was wet because it had been raining）。與過去完成式（had＋過去分詞，強調完成/結果）相對：had been reading 強調持續時間、had read 強調已讀完。形式鐵律：had been waiting（不是 had waiting／had being）；進行式用現在分詞 waiting（不是過去分詞 waited）。MCQ 每題唯一可辯護正解＋distractor_rationales＋answer_evidence。R14：teach body 全英文、中文放 zh_hint。以 Swan/Cambridge/Oxford 查證、status provisional、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。含純文字 shadowing（無音檔）。

units.title_zh: 過去完成進行式（had been ＋ V-ing）
units.can_do: 我能用過去完成進行式（had been ＋ V-ing）表達『到過去某時點為止一直持續』的動作，常搭配 for／since，也能用它說明過去某狀況的原因。
units.situation_group: 動詞時態 The past perfect progressive
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The past perfect progressive is formed with 'had been' + the -ing form of the verb (present participle): 'They had been working all day.'
claims.verification_ref: 過去完成進行式＝had been ＋ V-ing（現在分詞）（They had been working all day）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: It describes an action that had continued for a length of time up to a point in the past, often with 'for' or 'since': 'By noon, we had been driving for six hours.' / 'She had been waiting since morning.'
claims.verification_ref: 表到過去某時點為止持續一段時間的動作，常搭配 for／since（By noon, we had been driving for six hours / She had been waiting since morning）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: It can explain the cause or result of a past situation — something that had been happening before another past moment: 'The ground was wet because it had been raining.'
claims.verification_ref: 可用來解釋過去某狀況的原因/結果（The ground was wet because it had been raining）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The past perfect progressive stresses the ongoing duration before a past point, while the simple past perfect ('had' + past participle) stresses that the action was completed: 'She had been reading for two hours' (duration) vs 'She had read the book' (completed).
claims.verification_ref: 過去完成進行式強調過去某點前持續的時間、過去完成式（had＋過去分詞）強調完成（She had been reading for two hours vs She had read the book）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: The past perfect progressive is 'had been' + the -ing form of the verb (the present participle). We use it to talk about an action that had been going on continuously up to a certain point in the past.
teach.zh_hint: 過去完成進行式＝had been ＋ 動詞的 -ing 形（現在分詞）。用來表達『到過去某個時點為止一直持續』的動作。

teach.body: When I arrived, they had been waiting for over an hour.
teach.zh_hint: When I arrived, they had been waiting for over an hour.（我到的時候，他們已經等了超過一個小時——到『我到達』這個過去時點為止一直在等）

teach.body: It is often used with 'for' (a length of time) or 'since' (a starting point) to stress how long the action had continued before a past moment.
teach.zh_hint: 常搭配 for（一段時間）或 since（起點），用來強調到過去某時點之前，動作已經持續了多久。

teach.body: By noon, we had been driving for six hours. / She had been studying English since she was six.
teach.zh_hint: By noon, we had been driving for six hours.（到中午，我們已經開了六小時的車）She had been studying English since she was six.（她從六歲就一直在學英文——到過去某點為止）

teach.body: It can also explain the cause of a past situation. Compare it with the simple past perfect ('had' + past participle): the progressive stresses the ongoing duration, while the simple past perfect stresses that the action was finished.
teach.zh_hint: 也可用來解釋過去某狀況的原因。和過去完成式（had＋過去分詞）相比：進行式強調『持續的時間』，過去完成式強調『已經完成』。

teach.body: His eyes were red because he had been crying. (ongoing) / By then, he had read the whole book. (completed)
teach.zh_hint: His eyes were red because he had been crying.（他眼睛紅紅的，因為他一直在哭——強調持續）By then, he had read the whole book.（到那時他已把整本書讀完——強調完成）

practice.stem: 填入正確：When I arrived, they ____ for over an hour.（我到的時候，他們已經等了超過一小時）

distractor_rationales.had waiting: 過去完成進行式要用 had been ＋ V-ing，缺了 been，had waiting 不合文法。
distractor_rationales.have been waiting: have been 是現在完成進行式；參考點 When I arrived 在過去，應用 had been。
distractor_rationales.were waiting: 過去進行式只講當時正在做，無法凸顯『到我到達之前已持續一小時』的累積時間，此處用 had been waiting。

practice.feedback: 到過去時點（When I arrived）為止持續一小時 → had been waiting。

practice.stem: 填入正確：Her eyes were red because she ____.（她眼睛紅紅的，因為她一直在哭）

distractor_rationales.has been crying: has been 是現在完成進行式；句子其餘部分是過去（eyes were red），要用 had been。
distractor_rationales.had been cried: 進行式要用現在分詞 crying（V-ing），不是過去分詞 cried。
distractor_rationales.was been crying: was been 不是正確的動詞形式；過去完成進行式是 had been ＋ V-ing。

practice.feedback: 用過去完成進行式說明過去狀況的原因 → had been crying。

practice.stem: 選出過去完成進行式（had been ＋ V-ing）形式完全正確的句子：
practice.answer: They had been studying English for three years before they moved abroad.
options: They had been studying English for three years before they moved abroad.
They had being studying English for three years before they moved abroad.
They had been studied English for three years before they moved abroad.
They have been studying English for three years before they moved abroad.

distractor_rationales.They had being studying English for thre: 過去完成進行式用 had been，不是 had being。
distractor_rationales.They had been studied English for three: 進行式要用現在分詞 studying（V-ing），不是過去分詞 studied。
distractor_rationales.They have been studying English for thre: before they moved（過去）表示參考點在過去，應用 had been 不是 have been。

practice.feedback: had been ＋ V-ing（studying），且參考點 before they moved 在過去 → had been studying。

practice.stem: 填入正確：The players were muddy because they ____ in the rain since noon.（球員全身泥巴，因為他們從中午就一直在雨中踢球）

distractor_rationales.have been playing: have been 是現在完成進行式；主句 were muddy 是過去，要用 had been。
distractor_rationales.had play: had 後面要接 been ＋ V-ing（had been playing），had play 不合文法。
distractor_rationales.were played: were played 是被動式；球員是主動踢球，且要表達持續到過去某點，用 had been playing。

practice.feedback: since noon ＋ 到過去時點為止持續 → had been playing。

practice.stem: 下列哪一句用過去完成進行式，強調『到過去某時點為止一直持續的動作』？
practice.answer: I had been reading for two hours when the lights went out.
options: I had been reading for two hours when the lights went out.
I read for two hours last night.
I have read many books this year.
I was reading when the lights went out.

過去簡單式，只陳述過去做過，沒有『到某過去時點為止一直持續』的意味。
現在完成式，連到現在、且非進行式，不是過去完成進行式。
過去進行式只表示『燈滅那一刻正在讀』，沒有凸顯『到那時為止已持續兩小時』的累積時間。

practice.feedback: had been reading for two hours when… → 到過去時點為止持續的動作，是過去完成進行式。

practice.stem: 填入正確：We ____ the mountain for hours before we finally reached the top.（我們爬了好幾小時才終於登頂）

distractor_rationales.had been climb: had been 後面要接 V-ing（climbing），不是原形 climb。
distractor_rationales.was climbing: 過去進行式無法表達『到登頂之前已持續好幾小時』的累積；且主詞 We 用 were 不是 was。
distractor_rationales.had been climbed: climbed 是過去分詞（被動意味）；主動持續的動作用現在分詞 climbing。

practice.feedback: for hours ＋ before we reached the top（過去時點）→ had been climbing。

shadowing.note: 朗讀練習（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：出聲讀出每句，had been 輕讀連在一起、V-ing 的動作稍清楚，感受『到過去某點為止一直在進行』的時間感。

lines.text: When I arrived, they had been waiting for over an hour.
lines.intonation: had been 輕讀、waiting 稍清楚、hour 句尾下收

lines.text: The ground was wet because it had been raining all night.
lines.intonation: raining 稍強調、all night 句尾下收
